subject: Entire east wing has no network access
description: Hi IT, the whole east wing floor lost internet about an hour ago, nobody on Engineering can work.
justification: Entire Engineering floor has no network access; nobody on that floor can work. This is blocking the entire team from working and has no workaround.

subject: Minor Wi-Fi weak spot near conference room
description: Signal is a bit weak in room 3B but fine everywhere else on the floor.
justification: Signal is usable elsewhere on the floor; only affects one meeting room. Cosmetic or minor annoyance with no impact on ability to work.

subject: VPN keeps dropping
description: James in Sales cannot keep a stable VPN connection while working remotely today.
justification: This is a problem.

subject: Password reset email missing
description: User's reset email never arrived; other systems still accessible.
justification: User can still access most tools; only this one reset is pending. Should be fixed this week; not stopping any deadline-critical work.

subject: Laptop stolen from car overnight
description: Company laptop with client data was stolen; needs emergency loaner and security response.
justification: Not a big deal, can wait.

subject: Monitor won't power on
description: Daniel's monitor is completely dead, blocking his work on a client deadline.
justification: Daniel has no working display and is blocked from a deadline-driven task, but a loaner monitor may resolve it same-day.

subject: Software crashes on export
description: Report export crashes every time, report due this afternoon.
justification: It crashes sometimes I guess, not sure how bad.

subject: Duplicate charge on corporate card
description: Same SaaS subscription charged twice; finance needs it resolved before month-end close.
justification: Finance needs this resolved before month-end close, affecting the accuracy of the close process.

subject: New hire needs design tool installed
description: Standard onboarding request, no deadline mentioned.
justification: New hire onboarding item, not time-critical, can be scheduled whenever convenient.

subject: MFA push notifications not arriving
description: User reinstalled MFA app; now completely locked out of all company systems.
justification: User cannot log into any company system without MFA, a total lockout with no available workaround.

subject: Recurring calendar invites duplicating
description: Calendar invites show up twice in the software; scheduling still works fine.
justification: Cosmetic clutter, doesn't block scheduling, but still needs looking at at some point I think maybe.

subject: Site-to-site link down between offices
description: Both HQ and Austin office lose access to shared systems.
justification: Both offices lose access to shared internal systems until restored.

subject: Keyboard has unresponsive keys
description: Several keys don't register; external keyboard available as stopgap.
justification: Slows typing but an external keyboard is available as a stopgap, so the user can keep working at reduced efficiency.

subject: Vendor threatening to suspend service
description: Unpaid invoice IT never approved; vendor threatens suspension today.
justification: Active vendor risk with service suspension imminent today, requiring urgent finance and IT coordination.

subject: Expense report rejected for missing PO
description: Reimbursement blocked but not operationally urgent.
justification: This is fine whatever.

subject: Docking station second monitor not detected
description: Single-monitor setup still works fine as a fallback.
justification: Single-monitor setup still works fine in the meantime; purely a convenience issue with no work blocked.

subject: Elevated admin rights requested
description: One-time optional install, can wait for next maintenance window.
justification: Installation is optional and can wait for the next maintenance window, so this is not urgent.

subject: Former contractor account still active
description: Security exposure — access should have already been revoked.
justification: Security exposure — access should have been revoked already, posing ongoing risk until deactivated.

subject: Annual cloud invoice higher than budget
description: Finance needs an explanation before approving payment this week.
justification: It's expensive.

subject: Wireless headset battery drains fast
description: Battery drains quickly but headset works fine plugged in.
justification: Headset still usable while plugged in, so this doesn't block calls, just reduces mobility.
